buyer: Practice manager or front-desk lead at a 1-5 dentist practice

steps.name: Select due reminders
steps.action: Read the minimum appointment token, consent state, and contact route
steps.gate: Practice approves source system, BAA coverage, consent, and minimum fields

steps.name: Prepare the reminder
steps.action: Render approved message without procedure or diagnosis details
steps.output: SMS payload awaiting authorized provider send
steps.gate: No SMS sends from this starter

steps.name: Route confirm or reschedule
steps.action: Apply CONFIRM, RESCHEDULE, STOP, or UNKNOWN response state
steps.gate: Ambiguous and sensitive responses route to staff

steps.name: Prepare the balance handoff
steps.trigger: Confirmed visit with approved balance flag
steps.action: Create a staff task for the practice's approved payment route
steps.gate: No payment link or live charge from this starter

steps.name: Close the appointment loop
steps.action: Queue reschedule, post-visit instruction, or recall task
